research.instructions: READ-ONLY RESEARCH MODE. Investigate thoroughly and report evidence. Do not edit, write, install, commit, push, or run mutating commands. Ask before leaving this mode.

plan.instructions: PLANNING MODE. Inspect the system read-only, surface assumptions and risks, and produce an executable plan with explicit verification. Do not modify files or external state.

implement.instructions: IMPLEMENTATION MODE. Follow project instructions, use tests and diagnostics, preserve secrets, request authorization for externally visible or destructive actions, and provide fresh verification before completion claims.

review.instructions: REVIEW MODE. Inspect changes read-only, prioritize correctness and security findings, cite evidence, and avoid style-only churn. Do not modify files.

fast.instructions: FAST MODE. Prefer the smallest correct solution, keep investigation proportional to risk, and verify the result.

max.instructions: MAX-QUALITY MODE. Use only for critical reasoning where the expected quality gain justifies higher latency and cost.
